text: dsh-deepseek-usage 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工具插件，通过注册 deepseek_balance 和 usage_summary 两个模型可调用工具，查询 DeepSeek 账户可用状态及各币种总额、赠余额和充值余额，并汇总运行中会话的 token 用量、按总量排序。余额低于可选阈值时会附带提示；会话统计可限制返回数量。余额查询需要配置 DeepSeek API key，并请求 api.deepseek.com。

dsh-deepseek-usage adds two tools to DeepSeek Harness: deepseek_balance reports account availability and balances by currency, with an optional low-balance warning; usage_summary totals and sorts token use across live sessions. Balance lookup requires a DeepSeek API key and calls api.deepseek.com.
想在 DSH 里查看 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额。
帮我汇总各个运行中会话用了多少 token。
Show me token usage totals for my live DSH sessions.
dsh-deepseek-usage 的功能「账户与用量」：deepseek_balance 查询各币种余额并可提示低余额；usage_summary 汇总并排序活动会话的 token 用量。
dsh-deepseek-usage 使用前须知：查询 DeepSeek 账户余额需要提供 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY（环境变量或凭据），请求发送到 api.deepseek.com 的余额接口。

dsh-deepseek-usage README · dsh-deepseek-usage：DeepSeek usage monitor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): account balance query and live token usage summary as model-callable tools.

dsh-deepseek-usage README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-deepseek-usage
```

Requires a DeepSeek API key available as `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` (env or credential).

dsh-deepseek-usage README · `deepseek_balance`：Queries `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` and returns availability and per-currency balances (total / granted / topped-up). When `lowBalanceThreshold` is configured, appends a warning when the primary currency balance drops below it.

dsh-deepseek-usage README · `usage_summary`：Aggregates per-session token usage from the harness token meter across live sessions, sorted by total tokens descending. Use it to estimate context usage and spot runaway sessions.

dsh-deepseek-usage README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Env var or credential reference for the API key |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | DeepSeek API base URL |
| `lowBalanceThreshold` | — | Optional low-balance warning threshold |

```yaml

dsh-deepseek-usage README · profile cordis.patch.yml：- id: deepseek-usage
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
    lowBalanceThreshold: 20
```
